description: Composite provenance figure: vertebrate and deep conservation of candidate patches, Lon-family electrostatics comparison, and cylindrical map of the human hexamer surface
code:
import os, numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd()
# ---- human metrics with same summary stats as comparators ----
PDB="7NG5"; d=pd.read_pickle(f"{OUT}/{PDB}_atoms_sasa.pkl")
P=np.load(f"{OUT}/{PDB}_phi150.npy"); A=np.load(f"{OUT}/{PDB}_dotarea.npy")
CH={('ARG','CZ'):1.,('LYS','NZ'):1.,('ASP','CG'):-1.,('GLU','CD'):-1.,('HIS','NE2'):0.1}
q=np.array([CH.get((a,b),0.) for a,b in zip(d.label_comp_id,d.label_atom_id)])
hum=dict(structure="Human LONP1 7NG5", organism="H. sapiens", dna="ssDNA/G4/GU-RNA (PMID 14739292, 18174225)",
         chains=6, netQ=round(q.sum(),1), totSASA=round(d.sasa.sum()), meanphi=round(P.mean(),3),
         fpos=round(float((P>0.6).mean()),3), areapos=round(float(A[P>0.6].sum())), top_patch_A2=3233, top_patch_phi=1.00)
comp=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/comparator_Lon_electrostatics.csv")
rows=[hum,
 dict(structure="E. coli LonA 6U5Z", organism="E. coli", dna="duplex TG-rich (PMID 19643080)", chains=6,
      netQ=6.0, totSASA=146500, meanphi=0.078, fpos=0.316, areapos=46312, top_patch_A2=32244, top_patch_phi=1.46),
 dict(structure="M. taiwanensis LonA 4YPL", organism="M. taiwanensis", dna="alpha-domain family binds duplex", chains=6,
      netQ=-53.4, totSASA=143295, meanphi=-0.135, fpos=0.191, areapos=27148, top_patch_A2=5981, top_patch_phi=1.21),
 dict(structure="T. onnurineus LonB 3K1J", organism="T. onnurineus (archaeal LonB)", dna="not reported", chains=6,
      netQ=-26.4, totSASA=132474, meanphi=-0.060, fpos=0.224, areapos=29654, top_patch_A2=1517, top_patch_phi=1.29)]
C=pd.DataFrame(rows); C.to_csv(f"{OUT}/Lon_family_electrostatics_comparison.csv",index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",250); print(C.to_string(index=False))

# ---- background basic retention in deep orthologs ----
cons=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/vertebrate_conservation_per_position.csv", index_col=0)
print("\n(background for deep orthologs computed from stored alignment columns is not cached; "
      "reporting vertebrate background only)")
NTD=[131,137,140,145,147,148,154,155,156,158,169,203,205,212,213,290,298,301,311,323]
CC=[357,367,368,374,378,381,386,388,392,393,401,404,405,411,414]
AAAa=[705,710,714,718,721,722]; PROTx=[785,786,790,793,796,811,815,822]

# ---- composite figure ----
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,9))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,3,height_ratios=[1,0.95],hspace=0.38,wspace=0.3)
# (a) conservation by set
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
sets=[("NTD apex\n(P30)",NTD),("coiled-coil\n371-414",CC),("AAA+ alpha\n705-722",AAAa),("protease exit\n(P22)",PROTx)]
bgb=[i for i in cons.index if cons.aa[i] in "KR"]
vals=[100*cons.basic[s].mean() for _,s in sets]; idn=[100*cons.ident[s].mean() for _,s in sets]
x=np.arange(4)
ax.bar(x-0.2,vals,0.4,label="basic (K/R) retained",color="#4C78A8")
ax.bar(x+0.2,idn,0.4,label="identical to human",color="#9ecae1")
ax.axhline(100*cons.basic[bgb].mean(),ls="--",c="#E45756",lw=1.2)
ax.text(3.45,100*cons.basic[bgb].mean()+0.6,"all K/R background",ha="right",fontsize=7.5,color="#E45756")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([s for s,_ in sets],fontsize=8); ax.set_ylim(60,102)
ax.set_ylabel("% of 110 vertebrate orthologues"); ax.set_title("(a) Vertebrate conservation",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5,loc="lower left")
# (b) deep ortholog retention
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
T=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/deep_ortholog_basic_retention.csv")
keep=["S. cerevisiae PIM1","A. thaliana LON1","E. coli LonA","B. thermoruber Lon"]
w=0.2
for i,sp in enumerate(keep):
    ax.bar(np.arange(4)+(i-1.5)*w, T[sp].values, w, label=sp.split()[0]+". "+sp.split()[1])
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(4)); ax.set_xticklabels(["NTD\napex","coiled\ncoil","AAA+\nalpha","prot\nexit"],fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("% positions basic in orthologue"); ax.set_title("(b) Deep (non-vertebrate) Lon orthologues",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=7)
# (c) family electrostatics
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2])
lbl=["Human\nLONP1","E. coli\nLonA","Mta\nLonA","Tonn\nLonB"]
ax.bar(lbl,C.top_patch_A2.values,color=["#4C78A8","#E45756","#72B7B2","#B279A2"])
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_ylabel("largest contiguous positive patch ($\\AA^2$)")
for i,v in enumerate(C.top_patch_A2.values): ax.text(i,v*1.15,f"{int(v)}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("(c) Lon-family surface comparison",fontsize=10)
ax2=ax.twinx(); ax2.plot(lbl,C.meanphi.values,"ko-",ms=5); ax2.set_ylabel("mean surface $\\phi$ (kT/e)",fontsize=8)
ax2.axhline(0,ls=":",c="0.6",lw=0.8)
# (d) human cylindrical map, full width
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,:])
dots=np.load(f"{OUT}/{PDB}_dots.npy"); O,axis=np.load(f"{OUT}/{PDB}_axis.npy")
xyz=d[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values
z=(dots-O)@axis; r=np.linalg.norm((dots-O)-np.outer(z,axis),axis=1)
o=np.argsort(np.abs(P))
s=ax.scatter(z[o],r[o],c=P[o],s=1.0,cmap="coolwarm",vmin=-2,vmax=2,rasterized=True)
plt.colorbar(s,ax=ax,label="screened-Coulomb potential (kT/e, 150 mM)",pad=0.01)
ax.axhline(16,ls="--",c="0.35",lw=1)
ax.text(-105,17.5,"r = 16 $\\AA$: axial channel below this line",fontsize=8,color="0.3")
pt=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/LONP1_7NG5_positive_patches.csv").sort_values("area_x_phi",ascending=False).head(8)
for _,p in pt.iterrows():
    ax.plot(p.z,p.r,'o',ms=6,mfc='none',mec='k')
    ax.annotate(f"P{int(p.patch)} {int(p.area_A2)}$\\AA^2$",(p.z,p.r),fontsize=7.5,textcoords="offset points",xytext=(4,5))
for z0,lab2 in [(74.6,"NTD 123-370"),(45,"coiled-coil\n371-414"),(-17,"AAA+ 415-758"),(-63,"protease 759-949")]:
    ax.annotate(lab2,(z0,-8),ha="center",fontsize=8,color="0.25",annotation_clip=False)
ax.set_xlabel("position along 6-fold axis, z ($\\AA$)      protease  <-->  NTD")
ax.set_ylabel("distance from axis, r ($\\AA$)")
ax.set_title("(d) Human LONP1 hexamer (PDB 7NG5): surface electrostatics in cylindrical coordinates; "
             "largest basic patch P30 is on the outer NTD apex, not in the channel",fontsize=10)
plt.show()
